notes_meta.headline: Alphabet crashed 12% on its Q3 miss, its worst day since 2004, and Marvell fell 13% with it. Amazon, Intel and Sandisk reported after the close, with Intel's results looking weak and AWS beating; Microsoft gave back its pop as capex stayed in focus
notes_meta.calendar: Week calendar. Fri Oct 30: reaction to the Amazon, Intel and Sandisk reports. Mon Nov 2: Apple (2pm PT) and Palantir (after close). Tue Nov 3: AMD (2pm PT), Astera (4:30pm ET), Lam's annual meeting and Snowflake Expedition (Nov 3-5). Wed Nov 4: Arm and Qualcomm (1:45pm PT). Thu Nov 5: MP Materials. Mon Nov 10: IBM ex-dividend. Mon Nov 17: Nvidia (confirmed). Pending, no date: the Qualcomm v. Arm royalty ruling (~$300M/yr at stake, Futurum est.). Chart picture: GOOG crashed 12.3% on 7x volume (RSI 15) after its Q3 miss, its worst day since the 2004 IPO, and MRVL fell 13.2% alongside. AMZN (−4.3%), MU (−5.0%), SNDK (−5.3% into its print) and INTC (−3.6% into its print) also fell. META bounced 2.0%, AAPL closed within 0.8% of its 52-week high, SOFI made a third straight breakout and IBM broke above its 20-day high (RSI 83). After the close: Amazon's AWS beat (+39%) but the quarter was called a miss; Intel beat on EPS but reports put it down ~20% after hours; Sandisk guided strongly and announced an 8-for-1 split. GOOG (RSI 15), META (28), HOOD and INTC (29/35) are the most oversold; IBM (83) is the most extended. Gaps: the after-hours moves to Amazon, Intel and Sandisk, and Alphabet's exact close vs reaction, settle in tomorrow's file; many articles could not be opened. Closes are from IBKR.
notes_meta.source: Chart: IBKR daily bars, 1 year to the Thu Oct 29 close (SMA 20/50/200, RSI14, 52-week high/low, prior 20-day high/low, volume vs 20-day avg; breakout = close above prior 20-day high). News/dates/results: stockanalysis.com, company releases and news pages fetched 2026-10-29 evening. est. = not company-confirmed; headline only = article not opened. Analyst targets/ratings excluded. The Fed held rates at 3.75-4.00% on Oct 28.
